question: Can the P4BB cell mechanism be sampled deterministically at high Poisson rates with exact coordinate/partition identity and acceptable realized moment error, as a generic hypothesis-bound reference simulator?

branch_rule.pass: Retain the deterministic independent-cell sampler only as a generic research reference mechanism; a later LOD/spatial hypothesis must preserve its cell statistics and labels.
branch_rule.fail: Close the sampler without seed, size, inverse, threshold or distribution rescue; retain analytic P4BB only.

forbidden: interpret cell independence as measured film NPS
interpret event count as microscopic grain or dye-cloud count
add spatial filtering, particle radius or scanner response
normalize realized fields to force target moments
render photographs or alter product defaults
claim_ceiling: Deterministic high-rate independent 48-micrometre measurement-cell reference sampling with exact coordinate/partition identity and bounded realized moments; independence is a generic hypothesis, not measured NPS, microscopic geometry, calibration or product rendering.
